newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan opposition pilot defects to Taleban.
newsitem.headline: Afghan opposition pilot defects to Taleban.

text.p: An Afghan opposition pilot defected with his Russian-made Su-22 jet and landed in the eastern city of Jalalabad on Tuesday, a Pakistan-based Afghan news service reported.

The Afghan Islamic Press said the pilot, identified as General Naqibullah Logari, had declared loyalty to the purist Islamic Taleban militia after arriving in Jalalabad from the northern opposition stronghold of Mazar-i-Sharif.
No other details were immediately available.

The defection follows a series of bombing raids launched by northern opposition leader General Abdul Malik on Kabul and the western city of Herat in the past few days. Taleban planes attacked the opposition-held city of Maimana last week.
